scope: Real single-chat transport with synthetic in-memory knowledge and model; no real Wiki or external model

evidenceNormalization.identifiers: Recipient/callback user and platform message IDs replaced after session closure with sha256(canonical JSON string), matching src/core.ts hash.
evidenceNormalization.legacyReplyMeasurements: contentBytes and contentHash measure the service reply BEFORE the smoke helper adds its synthetic-test prefix. They are not full wire-body measurements. The current helper records wireBytes and wireBodyHash including the prefix.
evidenceNormalization.retained: Timestamps, event order, normalized outcomes and synthetic answer IDs unchanged.
